workingOn.title: Workflow state for agents
workingOn.summary: Working on the product and systems that turn ambiguous requests into changes people can understand, review, and trust.

question.prompt: How much of an agent's intermediate state should a person have to see?
question.currentView: Visible proposals, ownership, and state make consequential work easier to inspect and recover.
question.counterargument: Better defaults, reversibility, and a clear activity record may create more trust than constant confirmation.
question.wouldChange: I would update this view after seeing which controls people actually use when an agent has reliable rollback and a legible history.

changedMyMind.previous: Chat was mostly a temporary interface for demonstrating models.
changedMyMind.changed: Working on longer-running tasks made the gap between a useful conversation and durable work impossible to ignore.
changedMyMind.current: Chat can remain useful while intent is forming, provided durable workflow state exists outside the conversation.
